item.description: Steve Donovan was retired for two days before he took on his new role as associate vice chancellor and executive director for Parkside Works, the partnership and workforce innovation office at the University of Wisconsin-Parkside. item.title: Rogers Behavioral Health employees in West Allis and Madison file petition to form union
item.description: Rogers Behavioral Health fired three mental health professionals at its West Allis clinic Feb. 9 after the employees gave notice that they were forming a union, according to a National Union of Healthcare Workers news release.

item.title: Quad’s chief operating officer adds president to title
item.description: Sussex-based marketing experience company Quad has promoted chief operating officer Dave Honan to president. Honan, who has been with Quad since 2009, will retain his current role as chief operating officer, adding the title of president. item.title: New coworking space under construction at The Grain in Delafield
item.description: Beloit-based Hendricks Commercial Properties announced Wednesday that construction is underway on Irontek, a new co-working concept coming to downtown Delafield. The project is located at The Grain‘s west building, 525 Main St. The 11,223-square-foot space is expected to open in summer 2026. The Grain is a two-building commercial development with about 80,000 square feet of space […]

item.title: UW-Parkside launches campus-wide AI fluency initiative
item.description: The University of Wisconsin-Parkside will partner with Microsoft and Kenosha-based Ordify AI to launch a new initiative to integrate artificial intelligence into the university’s curriculum and campus operations.

item.title: New DWD grant program to support worker training in advanced manufacturing, AI
item.description: The DWD has received $7.3 million to support employers training their employees in advanced manufacturing and artificial intelligence.

item.title: New Wisconsin consortium will work to grow state’s fusion energy ecosystem
item.description: A newly awarded $778,000 grant from WEDC will support the creation of the Wisconsin Fusion Energy Consortium.

item.title: New ‘Founder Factory’ program will support Wisconsin’s startup pipeline
item.description: Founder Factory aims to address “long-standing gaps” in the early and middle stages of the startup pipeline.

item.description: Building technology company Johnson Controls, which is based in Ireland but has operating headquarters in Glendale, on Wednesday announced that it has reached an agreement to acquire Boston-based Alloy Enterprises.
